column3: In order to undertake this quest, you must first meet the following requirements:

1. FINAL FANTASY XIV: Dawntrail must be registered to your service account.
2. You must be a beastmaster.

3. You must have completed the First Master's Board.
4. You must have befriended at least thirty beasts.
Your performance within the Crucible has been astounding. We're all in quite the ruffle!
Lady Lauda not least of all. She has been most restless, most secretive of late... Why, it was only thanks to the keenest of my senses that I discovered she added yet another board!
A board upon which, I understand, Lady Lauda herself shall challenge you─together with Ser Guttler!
Can you believe it!? A return match like no other!
Your bout will no doubt feel personal, but you mustn't let your guard down. Those two may be nigh unstoppable with their powers combined.
However, I have every faith that *you* will emerge the victor. Sally forth, Lady Player─to triumph!
The Second Master's Board has been unlocked. To challenge it, speak with Lauda in Bentbranch Meadows.
